title: Currency symbol placement consistency
gherkin:
Given a system displaying monetary values
When monetary amounts are displayed in different parts of the application
Then all currency symbols should be placed in the same position relative to the numeric value
rationale: Ensures that currency symbols are consistently positioned (e.g., always before or always after the amount) across the entire system
generationSummary: Monetary representation consistency requirement ensures that all monetary values throughout the system are displayed and handled in a consistent format, including currency symbols, decimal places, and number formatting conventions.
